profile.name: ACQ400 原始数据网络客户端
profile.description: 用于 ACQ400/ACQ2106 数据采集系统的非物理主机端网络客户端，通过设备服务端口读取原始二进制数据，可用于实验中的通道数据拉取、分块传输和采集后数据处理。
profile.description_en: A non-physical host-side network client for ACQ400/ACQ2106 data acquisition systems. It reads raw binary data from device service ports and is used for channel data retrieval, block transfer, and post-acquisition data handling in experiments.
